decisions.statement: The server reads its certificate once as the server starts.
A renewed certificate reaches the server in a new pod rather than in the running pod.
The pod template carries the hash of the headscale-tls secret.
The keys hashed from the headscale-tls secret are tls.crt and tls.key.
The pod template carries the hash of the headscale-s3-creds secret.
The keys hashed from the headscale-s3-creds secret are access_key and secret_key.

definition: the workload, service and policies running the server that admits machines to the private network
